changes: Separate Agent Feeds, Harness Files and Overnight / AFK Work into three visually distinct cards on the homepage and pricing page.
Move prices out of the introductory hero into a dedicated offering section; preserve setup and access routes.
State the actual local Overnight / AFK Preview scope, included without extra charge with Harness Files; no hosted service or new paid tier is activated.
Preserve the $4.99 standard Feeds price, free through December 31, 2026 Eastern with explicit paid opt-in, and existing $29 library checkout.

edge_readback.scope: exact bodies, required headers and export marker on baltor.ai

live_full_public_route_map.scope: Desktop/phone, actual light/dark appearance and subdomain roots; read-only requests, no sign-ins or form submissions.

retained_attempts: Local full browser attempts 01 through 03 found obsolete selectors, whitespace, caption contrast and ambiguous locators; corrected final attempt04 passed all checks and wrong controls.

The first edge operator invocation failed on an incompatible MCP client import before effects. The next prepared an export but lacked SecretStorage before credential access or provider writes. A wrapper used the existing compatible MCP environment and appended installed pure-Python keyring dependencies; no package was installed.
The first independent host preflight had one transient demo.baltor.ai edge-status transport failure; page and CSS bytes were already current. The complete second attempt passed.
limits: Three visible offerings are not three active paid plans. New-signup $29.99 and a $49.99 hosted offering remain unfinished; existing prices, subscriptions and grants are unchanged.
No candidate files or feeds were published, provider products activated, models called, identity migrated or body-storage engine changed by this release.
Checks use headless Chromium and emulated viewports, not a physical-device or owner's browser-session test.

The 67-page audit checks public rendering and navigation, not every authenticated journey or the truth of every marketing sentence. A separate copy review found overstated overnight outcomes; corrections are a follow-up, not part of this image.
